diagnosis.chosen: Set S["evading"] = True when evade_on becomes True; fixes root cause where evasion logic is skipped despite trigger
diagnosis.target: S["evading"] state variable update in evasion trigger section
diagnosis.direction:
1. In evasion trigger block, after setting S["evade_on"] = True, add S["evading"] = True.
2. Ensure S["evading"] is reset to False when evasion ends (after cool_down or force end).
3. Verify 'early' condition now correctly activates evasion-specific logic like distance-prioritized stopping.
4. Remove redundant checks that rely on S["evading"] being pre-set.
5. Maintain all existing evasion parameters; fix only state flag propagation.
6. This ensures robot enters evasion behavior when trigger fires, addressing all collision cases where evade_on was True but robot kept moving.
